title: XL-DURel: Finetuning Sentence Transformers for Ordinal Word-in-Context Classification

selection.evidence: Found by searching HF for usage-similarity models newer than XL-LEXEME after three arena-lsc tickets pointed at the representation as the bottleneck; opened expecting a graded-WiC model might separate senses better.

cost.compute_notes: PDF sections 1-6 + appendix B read (data, losses, thresholds, results); author list from the arXiv/HF pages as printed. Model (HF sachinn1/xl-durel) run on ~100k usages (RX 6700 XT, fp16) in arena-lsc ticket 2026-11-03-XLDURel; reference marking code (PyPI xl-durel-utils 1.0.4) read, not executed.

claims.statement: Fine-tuning XLM-R large with AnglE loss on CoMeDi ordinal WiC data (71k usage pairs from DWUG-family datasets in ZH EN DE NO RU ES SV, 70/20/10 split by target word) plus XL-LEXEME's binary WiC data gives ordinal Krippendorff alpha .67 on CoMeDi test vs .58 for XL-LEXEME and .66 for the CoMeDi winner DeepMistake.
claims.scope: Threshold-binned cosines (thresholds tuned per language on dev); one training run per model (re-runs varied by +-.01-.03).

our_assessment.why: Numbers as printed (one run per model; the authors report +-.01-.03 re-run variation, so .67 vs .66 is a tie). The gain over XL-LEXEME is large on in-distribution ordinal WiC. CONTAMINATION for downstream LSC evaluation: its training pairs come from DWUG EN/DE/SV, DWUG ES, RuShiftEval, NorDiaChange, ChiWUG, so any evaluation on those datasets' words (and DWUG DE Sense, which reuses DWUG DE usages) is not clean.

claims.statement: As the encoder for SemEval-2027 Task 3 Subtask 1 (average-linkage clustering, threshold chosen on contamination-free public sets), XL-DURel beats XL-LEXEME on 1a by a small margin on held-out synthetic data (+0.012, 95% CI [+0.004, +0.021], 300 words) and on clean real sets (Italian +0.046, Russian +0.025, Finnish 0.000), does not improve 1b (synthetic -0.009, n.s.), and is slightly below on the task's 10-word Swedish dev set (-0.013, CI [-0.030, +0.000]).
claims.scope: arena-lsc ticket 2026-11-03-XLDURel; official Task 3 scorer; thresholds XL-DURel 0.54, XL-LEXEME 0.40.

our_assessment.why: Reader's own pre-registered comparison; the graded-WiC gain transfers to sense clustering only weakly.

checked.how: .venv-gpu/Scripts/python.exe tooling/embed.py <usages.jsonl> <out> --model sachinn1/xl-durel (arena-lsc; WordTransformer marking, mean pooling as its 1_Pooling config)
checked.result: usable; on an exFAT cache two config files must be fetched manually (HF symlink failure)

relations.why: Same architecture and marking scheme, further trained on ordinal judgments.
CoMeDi training pairs are drawn from DWUG-family annotations.

open_questions: Does averaging XL-DURel and XL-LEXEME cosines beat either alone on Task 3 1a?
